name: round5_training_variants
schedule: fixed:8 (auto-clamps to 7 for the pred_horizon=8 model)

training.script: teammate cotrain.py copy (not redistributed), model shared

B0.change: baseline: defaults (obs_horizon 2, pred_horizon 16, act_horizon 8, encoder_dim 128, no obs normalization)

V1.change: observation normalization: standardize obs by training-demo mean/std at dataset level and at rollout time; stats stored in the checkpoint
V1.patch: about 20 lines across our copies of cotrain.py + cotrain_prepare.py; no architecture or hyperparameter change

V2a.change: prediction horizon 8 with act_horizon 7 (= pred - obs + 1, the legal max)

decision_rule: variant counts as better only if EVERY primary seed exceeds the better B0 seed by more than the |B0_s0 - B0_s1| spread AND exact McNemar p < 0.05 against that B0 seed on the same eval seeds; otherwise 'not distinguishable from training noise'
gate: Task 1 training-speed benchmark: MPS 0.0191 s/update -> 30000 updates ~0.16 h <= 1 h so the full 30k-updates-per-model plan runs
